title: Dream world PT 1
content: (For context this is a real dream I've had and is not made up) I usually come to in the middle of a school hallway unable to find my class.(an elementary school I went to as a child) The hallways are endless lockers and it becomes a maze the farther you go. Almost every time A teacher finds me in the hallway and tells me I need to come to the gym or that a random class is about to begin. So while I enter every one is just acting as if it's a real world. But I slowly notice theres no coordinated game or anything making sense. I get an off putting feeling that something isnt right once I recognize I'm an adult in a school. Everyone starts looking at me. So I start to see that this isnt real. Within seconds I think well let's see if I can fly if this is a dream. So I double jump like people do in minecraft and immediately I could fly. (IRL I have asthma so in my dreams when I can run or dance without being out of breath I take advantage of it.) So I hovered and dance as if I'm hanging onto silk drapes like Aerial silks. I dance and flip around the gymnasium as if no ones watching. I can feel my auras energy and honestly love flying and dancing in the dream it makes me happy to be seen as a treasure because I'm the only one that can fly in my dreams. Once I'm fully aware by this point that I'm dreaming I fully can remember I'm in my early 20's, from Earth, year 2025 and that I'm really in my bed dreaming. I feel and uneasy feeling that its completely inappropriate for an adult to be taking kid classes with elementary students. So I try to escape the school. But the teachers always never want me to leave despite me claiming I'm an adult. I always run away, or skateboard away, or bike away, or fly away to try and get back home. Everytime a teacher or school staff chases me. If I ever make it home something bad always happens. So I know when I leave I must just keep wondering and exploring. If I stay in one place to long things get really weird. The school is the main spot I go to. Now the bathroom situation. When I'm dreaming I never try and use the bathroom. So I haven't experienced the endless dirty bathrooms yet...
